title: scval.to_native merges ScMap keys that convert to the same native key and drops entries silently
severity_basis: Silent loss of map entries in the native conversion (scval.to_native); the XDR itself decodes and re-encodes unchanged. The same class was fixed in js-stellar-sdk (issue #1789, F-0018).

entries.expected: every map entry survives the conversion, or the conversion fails
entries.observed: Executed on 17.0.0 and 17.0.1: scval.to_native returns a dict with 1 entry and no error for a map with the three distinct keys bool true, u32 1 and i32 1 (true == 1 in Python).

entries.expected: every map entry survives the conversion, or the conversion fails
entries.observed: Executed on 17.0.0 and 17.0.1: scval.to_native returns a dict with 2 entries and no error for a map with the three distinct keys u32 1, string "1" and symbol "1" (the string and the symbol convert to the same str).

evidence.pre_fix: Conformance runner (xcc conform run --columns 'python@*' --entries 'cap-0046/scval-map-keys-collide-three-types.*'), L3, on python@17.0.0 and python@17.0.1.
evidence.expected_basis: SCMap is a vector of entries with distinct SCVal keys (https://github.com/stellar/stellar-xdr/blob/v30.0/Stellar-contract.x#L236; CAP-46): u32 1, i32 1 and bool true are different keys, so a conversion that maps them to one native key must keep every entry or fail.

reproduction.method: Independent reviewer reproduction from the record alone: 4 of 4 listed report rows failed again as recorded, offline. Failed again in the offline conformance runs of 2026-11-14.

evidence_added.reason: Filed upstream by a third party on 2026-11-13 with its own reproduction and a fix pull request (#1252); no new evidence added.
